title: Add Google Search Console verification meta tag site-wide

requirements.summary: Add the provided Google Search Console verification meta tag to the global HTML head so it is present on every route.
acceptanceCriteria: The rendered document <head> includes exactly: <meta name="google-site-verification" content="hym4U2k_e6Y32exhxiM5yIhLCPh_rYLDWpY5B2Mr9wQ" />
The meta tag is present for all pages/routes (site-wide), not only a single page component
No other <head> metadata is removed or altered unintentionally (existing title/viewport/charset remain intact)

file_operations.description: Insert <meta name="google-site-verification" content="hym4U2k_e6Y32exhxiM5yIhLCPh_rYLDWpY5B2Mr9wQ" /> into the global <head> so it is included site-wide across all routes, keeping existing charset/viewport/title tags intact.

requirements.summary: Ensure the update introduces no design/styling/layout/routing/content changes beyond adding the verification meta tag.
acceptanceCriteria: No visual/UI/layout changes are introduced across the site aside from the added head meta tag

file_operations.description: Limit the change to adding the single Google Search Console verification meta tag only; do not alter existing head metadata, markup structure, scripts, or any app UI-related code.

requirements.summary: Ensure the updated frontend build is published so production includes the new global head meta tag.
acceptanceCriteria: A new production build is deployed that includes the verification meta tag in the global <head>

file_operations.description: After committing the global <head> meta tag change, run the normal frontend build-and-publish workflow for this project and verify the deployed production HTML <head> includes the verification meta tag.
